mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements about the All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC): 1. It is India's oldest central trade union. 2. It was founded in 1947. 3. N.M. Joshi was one of its co-founders. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq_fix.why: statement 1 cited an answer key instead of a fact; answer unchanged (yfe74afcfb93)

mcq_drop.why: stem quotes an answer key; 'observationalists' is not a standard term
opinion/debate statements, not a factual test

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: awards (Indira Gandhi Peace Prize); suspect key: 2003 prize went to Kofi Annan
wrong topic: scheme convergence in administration

patterns: APPSC asks founding facts (N.M. Joshi set up AITUC in 1920) and definitional items (lobbying, NGOs' role, pressure group examples).
Identify-the-pressure-group trap: trade union members yes; MPs, cabinet, panchayat members no.
Movement-leader matching (Chipko-Bahuguna, NBA-Medha Patkar, Appiko-Hegde) with a wrong pair to spot.
FCRA asked through a current case (PHFI, lobbying); Press Council as statutory quasi-judicial body.
App adds many 2026 FCRA rule details and opinion-style civil-society statements; PYQs stay single-fact.
